purpose: Score the untouched IoT-23 malware holdout exactly once with the frozen validation policy, and report the result whatever it is. Fixed before any holdout byte is downloaded.

capture_topology.rule: IoT-23 names each primary capture after the infected device's address. That address is the device; its /24 is the LAN. Declared here from the file names in the selection manifest, before any byte is read.

audit_gate.rule: Scoring is refused unless every capture has at least one EGRESS packet from its declared device and its declared LAN, and every pcap and label file matches the SHA-256 recorded in the selection manifest.

labels: window-label-1, applied by the frozen data.samplepack.build builder; unknown windows are excluded, never counted as benign
reported: per capture and per role (seen family, unseen family): malicious windows, anomalous malicious windows, window recall at the frozen threshold
per capture: whether the N = 2 / 300 s policy quarantined the device, delay from the first malicious window to the first quarantine, and the malicious window-time blocked (interval overlap)
per capture: benign-labelled windows inside the infected capture and how many were flagged, reported separately and never as a benign-device FPR
untouched benign FPR: not measured (ADR-0004 decision 7c)

one_shot.rule: The scorer refuses to run if data/holdout/score_record.json exists. The record is committed after the only run, so a second run needs that commit reverted in review. Whatever the result, it is reported; any adjustment afterwards consumes this holdout.

never: train, validate, or choose a threshold, N, lease or feature on these captures
score before every hash is recorded and the audit gate passes
report a pooled number as a benign-device FPR
